sensor_model: Ideal circular horizontal footprint, radius 50 m; active straight scanning legs only. Transit legs do not scan. No 3D/occlusion/dwell-time model.
lane_axis: Local east-west; rows ordered south to north, serpentine left/right
supplemental_rule: Consider missed polygons from largest to smallest; choose the first representative-point scan with positive exact missed-area gain from the selected navigation domain. Short horizontal scan or vertical fallback. Preserve all residuals, including those without gain; maximum64 scans.

coverage_definitions.coverage_ratio: union of clipped active scan footprints / original A1 candidate area
coverage_definitions.missed_ratio: original candidate minus active footprint union / original candidate area
coverage_definitions.repeated_ratio: area visited by at least two active scan legs / original candidate area
coverage_definitions.excess_fraction_of_pass_area: sum of per-active-leg footprint areas minus union area, divided by summed pass area

limitations: Point-platform position polyline; heading discontinuities are not finite-curvature turns
No USV/UUV task allocation, tracking, depth dynamics or actual mission authorization evaluated
scan_center_policy: Use the largest four-connected conservative-grid component as the selected starting navigation domain. Other components remain in the original full A1 coverage target and are never removed from the coverage denominator.
method_revision: Initial5m all-run visitation explicitly failed at a disconnected connector. 2.5m refinement restores one previous connection but leaves3 grid components. Revised scan-centre domain is declared before this run; target SHA, sensor footprint, spacing and coverage threshold stay unchanged.
manifest_reference_policy: a1_manifest_sha256 records the original A1 reference snapshot. A fresh preparation may change timestamps/code metadata; exact target, hazard geometry and source config hashes must still match.
